▒▒▒▒鍵▒▒▒▒

Rain falls on every visor the same. Only one face comes through.

$CIPHR is a token on Pons. A qualifying buy lets the buyer claim one voxel helmet, one per wallet, for a small network fee. Its visor is being built as AES-256-GCM ciphertext sealed inside a Phala Cloud dstack TDX enclave, and the chain keeps only that ciphertext and a commitment. To every other eye it is noise. To the current holder, one signature and the face resolves.

The helmet is a key that opens more than its own visor. Its holder gets an Encrypt box for text or a file, sealed for themselves, a chosen wallet or any current holder, and only a current CIPHR opens it. Pass the helmet on and the licence walks with it. What was already downloaded stays downloaded.

A face can leave the noise once. The reveal is signed by an enrolled enclave key and stays public through every transfer. The key does not turn back.

Generation is being built with Chutes confidential compute on Bittensor SN64. Until deployment, attestation and enrollment are verified, helmets, reveals and the Encrypt box stay closed, and every cell stays ▒.
